role: Intern-Stage Onboard and Network Developer - Développeur de systèmes de bord et de réseau
jd:
Job Summary

The Intern, Onboard and Network Developer is responsible for collaboration in the life cycle of software engineering, setting up, and delivering solutions for Locomotive onboard, Wayside remote devices and Interoperable Train Control network. The role specializes in delivering solutions to all stakeholders and contributes to design decisions that drive the integration of application and solutions.

Main Responsibilities



- Define and develop applications and services.
- Define, develop Unit Test code aligned with specifications and standards.
- Integrate and configure components of communication services.
- Configure Internet of Things (IoT) devices based on design specification.
- Participate in test planning and execution.
- Establish and plan deployment strategies.
- Define deployment Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
- Capture and analyse deployment data.
- Troubleshoot issues and help developers in proposing solutions.
- Take part in daily scrum team meetings, sprint planning, and retrospective.
- Create design, build and run documentation.
- Transfer knowledge to support teams.

Working Conditions



- This position operates in a professional office environment and follows a regular Monday to Friday work schedule, with standard business hours.
- The incumbent must be available to work in a hybrid model, requiring a minimum of four (4) days per week in the office, with opportunities for remote work in accordance with company policies and business needs.
- The role involves managing priorities and delivering work within established timelines, with support from the team to ensure sustainable and effective workload management.
- This role also requires the ability to work legally in Canada.

Experience



- Collaborates with others and shares information.
- Proficiency in analytical and critical thinking to solve problems and create value.
- Looks for opportunities for continuous improvement and takes initiative.
- Initiative and eagerness to learn from industry professionals and contribute to projects.
- Time management skills and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
- Communicate with impact both orally and written.
- Strong ability to collaborate and share timely information with and across functions/field personnel and technical stakeholders to get things done effectively.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Education/Certification/Designation



- Working towards a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent.

Competencies



- We Care About Each Other
- We Strive for Excellence
- We Succeed Together
- We Lead Responsibly

Technical Skills/Knowledge



- Advance Knowledge of Python, C++ and Java programing language.
- Knowledge with Linux Operating systems configuration and scripting.
- Ability to install, integrate, troubleshoot and demonstrate solution applications.
- Ability do work with cloud environment (e.g., Virtual Machine, Micro services).
- Advanced knowledge of networking and advance switching concepts.
- Knowledge of monitoring systems leveraging Message Brokers (*MQ).
- Knowledge of Agile Development Operations and concepts related to continuous integration and pipeline management
- Knowledge of data analysis using Power BI and Grafana.
- Proficient use of MS Office 365 tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint Word, Notes).
- Experience with building AI Agents to automate and improve processes.
- Fluently bilingual, both written and verbal (English, French*).
- Any experience/skills/knowledge for these above would be considered as an asset

Additional Information (If Any)



- N/A.
fit_why: Onboard/network/IoT embedded-adjacent; French fluency required, capped at 3

role: Intern-Stage Business Development - Développement des affaires
jd:
Job Summary

At CN, every day brings new and exciting challenges. You can expect an engaging environment where you are part of making sure our business runs safely, efficiently, and sustainably while meeting our customers needs and keeping the economy on track.The Business Development Intern supports customer growth initiatives across CN's network. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Development managers and cross-functional teams to evaluate the process used to bring on new customer opportunities, shadow and support customer development projects, conduct market analysis, and assist in continuous improvement initiatives to drive a better customer experience.This role provides direct exposure to various departments within CN, transportation supply chains, project development, customer engagement, and internal CN process.

Main Responsibilities



- Assist in evaluating new customer and market opportunities across CN's network.
- Conduct industry, market, and supply chain research to identify growth opportunities.
- Drive the assessment of key business development processes and deliver recommendations for process improvement.
- Perform competitive, economic, and transportation market assessments.
- Support Business Development managers on the development of customer on-board and project development, from concept to execution.
- Assist with project scheduling, documentation, action tracking, and stakeholder coordination.
- Participate in meetings with internal and external project stakeholders.
- Review project information, technical reports, site plans, and supporting documentation.
- Help prepare materials for project approvals and executive presentations.
- Help prepare materials for external presentations.
- Collaborate with teams including Engineering, Transportation, Service Design, Real Estate, Finance, Public Affairs, and Marketing.
- Support customer-facing projects in collaboration with Business Development managers.
- Assist with meeting preparation, presentations, and communications.
- Maintain project tracking tools and Business Development databases.
- Review process and evaluate opportunities integrate Artificial Intelligence into processes
- Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations for management review.
- Perform data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting activities.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance business processes and project execution.

Working Conditions



- This position operates in a professional office environment and follows a regular Monday to Friday work schedule, with standard business hours.
- The incumbent must be available to work in a hybrid model, requiring a minimum of four (4) days per week in the office, with opportunities for remote work in accordance with company policies and business needs

Experience



- Experience with data analysis, report preparation and use of artificial intelligence tools

Education/Certification/Designation



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline

Competencies



- We Care About Each Other
- We Strive for Excellence
- We Succeed Together
- We Lead Responsibly

Technical Skills/Knowledge



- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and Gemini/CoPilot

Additional Information (If Any)

The intern will complete one or more process improvement projects that deliver measurable business value to CN while developing practical experience in transportation, infrastructure development, and commercial strategy. Expected deliverables may include business case for adjustment, market studies, customer opportunity assessments, project coordination support, and executive presentations.
fit_why: Business development and market analysis; no software engineering work
